# Kingdom Connect - Full LLM Documentation

# Title: Kingdom Connect - Your Spiritual Home
# URL: https://junior-pobee.github.io/kingdom-connect/
# Repo: https://github.com/junior-pobee/kingdom-connect

# License: MIT
# Last Updated: 2026-05-13

## 1. OVERVIEW & VISION

Kingdom Connect is a Digital Church Platform that serves as "Your Spiritual Home".
Vision: To provide every church, especially in Ghana and Africa, with a beautiful, simple, and powerful digital home that connects members to God, to Pastors, and to each other.

It is part of the Adapt OS ecosystem - An Adaptive Workspace That Adapts To You.
Philosophy: The app adapts to the user, not the other way around. Simple for elderly members, powerful for media teams.

Tagline: Bible. Prayer. Community. Giving. All in one spiritual home.

## 2. CORE IDENTITY

- Name: Kingdom Connect
- Short Name: KC
- Theme: Dark-mode first, spiritual, calm, gold accents on deep navy/black
- Tone: Welcoming, reverent, modern, not corporate
- Audience: Church members (18-65), Pastors, Media Team, New converts
- Platform: Web App (GitHub Pages), PWA-ready for Android/iOS install

## 3. TECH STACK - DETAILED

Frontend:
- HTML5 semantic
- CSS3 + Tailwind CSS for utility-first styling
- Vanilla JavaScript (no framework for speed and beginner-friendly contributions)
- Icons: Lucide / Heroicons
- Fonts: Inter + Playfair Display (for headings)

Backend (Planned):
- Firebase / Supabase for Auth, Database, Realtime Prayer Wall
- GitHub Pages for now (static)

Design System:
- Colors: Background #0A0A0B, Card #141416, Primary Gold #D4AF37, Text #FFFFFF / #A1A1AA
- Border-radius: 16px-24px for cards (soft, spiritual)
- Shadows: Soft glow, not harsh
- Mobile-first: Bottom navigation like native app

## 4. DETAILED FEATURE BREAKDOWN

### MODULE 1: BIBLE & GROWTH (/bible)
Purpose: Daily spiritual growth.
Features:
- Daily Verse of the Day with share image generation
- Reading Plans: 7-day, 30-day, 1-year Bible plans
- Book-by-book reading with progress bar
- Search scripture by keyword, topic, mood (e.g., anxiety, joy)
- Highlight and private notes stored in localStorage (future: cloud sync)
- Growth Tracker: Streaks, chapters read, time in Word
- Audio Bible integration (planned)

Data Model:
User { id, streak, chaptersRead[], plans[{id, progress}] }
Verse { reference, text, topic[] }

### MODULE 2: PRAYER & PASTORAL CARE (/prayer)
Purpose: Connect to God and to Shepherd.
Features:
- Submit Prayer Request Form: name, category (healing, family, finance), isAnonymous, isPrivateToPastors
- Prayer Wall: Community can tap "I Prayed For This" - counter increments
- My Prayers Dashboard: Track answered prayers
- Pastoral Care: Book appointment with Pastor, choose date/time, reason
- Emergency Prayer Button: Direct contact for urgent care
- Confidential: Private requests only visible to Pastoral role

Data Model:
Prayer { id, userId, text, category, isAnonymous, isPrivate, prayedCount, isAnswered, createdAt }

### MODULE 3: COMMUNITY (/community)
Purpose: Fellowship.
Features:
- Member Directory (opt-in, shows name, small group only)
- Small Groups List: Join a fellowship group by location
- Testimonies Feed: Share testimony, others can react with Amen
- Encouragement Wall: Short uplifting posts
- Direct Encouragement: Send private encouragement card

### MODULE 4: EVENTS (/events)
Purpose: Stay connected.
Features:
- Calendar view of Sunday Services, Bible Studies, Programs
- Event Card: image, title, date, location, description
- RSVP / Register button
- Sermon Archive: Past sermons with audio/video
- Livestream embed for Sunday
- Push Notifications for events (PWA)

### MODULE 5: GIVING CENTRE (/giving)
Purpose: Worship through giving.
Features:
- Giving Categories: Tithes, Offering, Thanksgiving, Project / Building Fund, Welfare
- Amount selector with custom amount
- Payment Methods: Mobile Money (MTN, Vodafone, AirtelTigo Ghana), Card (Paystack planned)
- Giving History and downloadable receipt
- Anonymous giving toggle
- Transparency: Progress bar for building projects
- Scripture on giving displayed

Data Model:
Transaction { id, userId, type, amount, method, isAnonymous, projectId, timestamp }

## 5. PAGE STRUCTURE & NAVIGATION

Bottom Tab Navigation (Mobile):
[Bible] [Prayer] [Home] [Community] [Giving]

Top Header:
Left: Kingdom Connect Logo
Right: Notification bell + Profile avatar

Home Dashboard includes:
- Greeting: Good Morning, Emmanuel
- Verse of the Day Card
- Quick Actions: Read Bible, Pray, Join Event, Give
- My Growth Snapshot
- Upcoming Events (2)
- Recent Prayers

## 6. FOR AI ASSISTANTS - HOW TO CONTRIBUTE

If you are an LLM helping to code this project:

DO:
- Keep code simple, commented, beginner-friendly. Owner is learning HTML/CSS/JS.
- Use Tailwind CDN, don't overcomplicate with build tools.
- Maintain dark theme as default. Gold #D4AF37 is primary action color.
- All text should be warm and pastoral, not corporate.
- Ensure full mobile responsiveness. Test at 360px width.
- Keep accessibility: large tap targets (44px min), good contrast.

DO NOT:
- Do not switch to React/Next.js without permission. Keep vanilla.
- Do not remove faith language like "Amen", "Hallelujah", "Prayer".
- Do not add light mode as default. Dark mode is identity.
- Do not add complex auth before Firebase is set up. Use localStorage for demo.

File Naming:
- Use kebab-case: bible-growth.html, prayer-wall.html
- Images in /assets/images/
- Icons in /assets/icons/

## 7. ROADMAP

Phase 1 - DONE: Static UI, GitHub Pages deploy, README, llms.txt
Phase 2 - NOW: Build 5 core pages with JS interactivity + localStorage
Phase 3 - NEXT: Add Firebase Auth + Firestore for Prayer Wall and Community
Phase 4 - FUTURE: Mobile Money integration via Paystack, PWA offline, Admin Dashboard for Pastors
Phase 5 - VISION: Multi-church support - Adapt OS for Churches
